content.title: Does Taylor Frankie Paul Have Kids?
content.text: Skip to main contentThe reality star is a mom of three. Meet her children, Indy, Ocean and Ever.Mar 19, 2026 4:31 PM EDTTaylor Frankie Paul attends the 98th Annual Oscars at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, California, on March 15, 2026. Gilbert Flores/Penske Media via Getty ImagesKey PointsTaylor Frankie Paul is a mom of three and a popular influencer from MomTok.She shares two children with ex-husband Tate Paul and one with Dakota Mortensen.Taylor prioritizes motherhood and maintains positive co-parenting relationships. Before stepping into the spotlight as the lead of The Bachelorette, which is now no longer moving forward at ABC, Taylor Frankie Paul was already known online as a young mom documenting her life on TikTok. The influencer, who rose to fame as part of the MomTok community and later starred on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, is a mother of three children.Read More Here’s everything to know about Taylor Frankie Paul’s kids. Related: ABC Officially Cancels Taylor Frankie Paul’s ‘Bachelorette’ Season Does Taylor Frankie Paul have any children? Yes, Taylor Frankie Paul has three children total. Two are with her ex-husband, Tate Paul, while one is with former partner Dakota Mortensen. YesYes70%NoNo30% Which children did Taylor Frankie Paul have with Tate Paul? Taylor Frankie Paul married her ex-husband Tate Paul in November 2016. Less than a year later, the couple welcomed their first child together—Taylor and Tate’s daughter, Indy May Paul, was born on Aug. 31, 2017. Taylor has often described Indy as both “sweet” and “sassy,” sharing photos of her daughter on social media throughout the years. She has also said Indy enjoys makeup, dresses and other girly activities. Taylor and Tate welcomed their second child, son Ocean Paul, on June 18, 2020. Related: Who Is Taylor Frankie Paul? Inside the Life of ‘The Bachelorette’ Season 22 Star Taylor documented much of her pregnancy and early motherhood journey with Ocean on TikTok, where she began building the audience that eventually turned her into a viral influencer. The couple later divorced in 2022 after Taylor revealed details about the viral MomTok “soft swinging” scandal involving members of their friend group. Despite their split, Taylor has said she and Tate now maintain a healthy co-parenting relationship for the sake of their children. Related: What Is ‘Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’? Inside the MomTok Swinging Scandal That Made Taylor Frankie Paul Famous Which children did Taylor Frankie Paul have with Dakota Mortensen? Following her divorce, Taylor began dating Dakota Mortensen. The relationship, which was featured on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, included several ups and downs before the couple welcomed a child together. Taylor and Dakota welcomed their son Ever True Mortensen on March 19, 2024. Taylor later shared that the name Ever symbolizes “always” and “eternity.” Although Taylor and Dakota eventually split, the two remain connected through co-parenting their son. Related: ‘The Bachelorette’ Season 22 Cast Revealed: ‘The Book of More-Men’ is Now Open Are Taylor Frankie Paul’s kids caught up in the recent controversies? Sadly, yes. When information of Taylor’s 2023 arrest for domestic violence became public, it was revealed that one of her children was in the room during one particularly charged incident. That was confirmed when TMZ revealed video footage of said incident, with a child in the presence of the couple as she hurled metal stools at Dakota.
